mentions.name: TextKit
mentions.description: A free, browser-based collection of 40 (and growing) tools for text processing, data cleaning, conversions, and developer utilities. Built with Flask and vanilla JS, it includes a Windows 95-style desktop mode where tools open as draggable windows.
mentions.problem: Basic data cleaning with pandas is repetitive, and similar online tools are completely riddled with ads.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a collection of 40 (and growing) tools for text processing, data cleaning, conversions, dev utils etc. Everything runs in the browser and is completely free.
